'''Gandalla''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] Gandalla was the site of an attempted assassination of a [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] by [[Brahle Logris]].
